name: notion
description: Notion: search pages and databases, read a page or database rows (with filter), create pages and update them (properties, text added at the end) through an internal integration. Nothing is deleted. Needs the integration secret; the pages must be shared with the integration.

tools.name: notion_check_connection
tools.description: Check the Notion connection (token) and show the integration and workspace.

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search the pages and databases that are shared with the integration, newest edit first. Read only.

tools.name: notion_read_page
tools.description: Read one page: title, properties and the text of its blocks. Read only.

tools.name: notion_query_database
tools.description: Read the rows of a database with their properties, optionally filtered and sorted. Read only.

tools.name: notion_create_page
tools.description: Create a page below a page or as a row in a database (this changes Notion). Ask the person before using it.

tools.name: notion_update_page
tools.description: Change properties of a page and/or add text at its end; nothing is deleted or archived (this changes Notion). Ask the person before using it.

notion_token.title: Integration secret
notion_token.description: notion.so/profile/integrations, New integration (internal), enable the capabilities Read content, Insert content and Update content, copy the secret. Then share each page or database with it (page menu, Connections). Stored as a secret.
